column2: Fixed: adjacency map construction now uses get/push on a Map instead of array spreads, removing the O(n²) copy behavior.
Fixed: validatePipelineStructure now iterates inputs via Object.entries, and validatePipelineInput validates type, required, secret, description, and default type consistency.
Fixed: findEntry now searches every pipeline in the project and returns the matching pipeline and entry instead of hard-coding pipelines[0].
Fixed: validateDependencyProducers checks every dependencies[].producer against existing step IDs before the RunPlan is built.
Fixed: secret input values are no longer embedded in RunPlan.inputs or in the content-addressed plan ID; they are omitted so the runtime resolves them from the secrets context by name.
Fixed: computeReachableSteps now follows only dependencies[].producer edges backward from the roots, matching the spec.
Fixed: bindRunPlan calls validateDependencyProducers before reachability computation so unknown producers fail fast with PlannerError(INVALID_GRAPH).
Fixed: graph preprocessing is split into buildProducerMap, keeping traversal logic separate from adjacency construction.
Fixed: every step dependency is validated to reference an existing step ID before the RunPlan is built.
Fixed: bindInputs now asserts that user overrides and defaults match the declared input type and rejects mismatches with PlannerError.
Fixed: reachability now follows only producer/prerequisite edges backward, so siblings of ancestors are no longer pulled in.
Fixed: findEntry now searches every pipeline in the project instead of defaulting to the first one.
